theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_st_interval_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (φ γ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → (∀ t, |γ t| ≤ 1) → a < b → |∫ t in a..b, deriv (fun s => φ s * γ s) t| ≤ 2 / (b - a) * (∫ t in a..b, |φ t|) + 2 * ∫ t in a..b, |deriv φ t|
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
